coordinates.note: No source consulted (checked 2026-09-17) gives a surveyed lat/lon for the NM4 building. The point recorded is the one used for the Fermilab main campus, with a precision of 3 km and uncertain confidence. Treat it as campus precision, not hall precision.

name: NM4 hall, Fermilab
notes: Coordinates reuse the same honestly-approximate Fermilab campus point as site:fermilab-main-campus rather than duplicating a fresh geocoder lookup; see coordinates.note.

The hall name ('New Muon 4 (NM4) Hall') is taken from the U.S. DOE categorical-exclusion determination CX-002672 (19 May 2010) for the Drell-Yan SeaQuest project, which describes the E906/SeaQuest spectrometer as proposed for that hall.

summary.plain: The Fermilab hall used by the SeaQuest Drell-Yan experiment, and proposed as the home of its DarkQuest successor.
summary.technical: NM4 Hall on the Fermilab fixed-target beamlines (Batavia, Illinois), housing the SeaQuest/E906 dimuon spectrometer on the 120 GeV Main Injector proton beam; proposed site of the DarkQuest dark-sector upgrade. No surveyed coordinate for this specific hall was found, so the Fermilab campus point is used at reduced precision.
